layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A - Tetris Grid)

global_3d.behavior: Continuous floating and rotating, mapped to scroll position via framer-motion useScroll or Drei ScrollControls. Camera reacts to mouse movement.

dom_elements.reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
dom_elements.parallax: Use useTransform to move DOM elements at different speeds than scroll

components_instructions.3d_hero: Full screen HTML section overlaid on a global R3F Canvas. Canvas should feature large sky-blue floating icosahedrons and white glossy toruses. Use Drei's <Float> for idle motion. Overlay HTML uses ultra-bold 'Outfit' text.
components_instructions.3d_service_cards: Use Glassmorphism specs. Add a 3D R3F Canvas inside the card containing a rotating abstract icon (e.g., floating graph, glowing sphere) for each service.
components_instructions.trust_strip: Horizontal Marquee (react-fast-marquee) with high-contrast logos, moving slowly, spaced generously (gap-24).
components_instructions.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button with a continuous floating animation (y-axis sine wave via Framer Motion) and glowing drop-shadow.
components_instructions.pricing_cards: Bento-style layout. Middle tier should be 'lifted' visually using scale and a stronger sky-blue glowing shadow. Use 3D hover tilt effects (framer-motion useMotionValue).
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top with 'Glassmorphism' specs. Must contain brand text, links, and primary CTA. Shrinks slightly on scroll.
components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses bg-sky-500 text-white hover:bg-sky-600. Add subtle scale on click.
components_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract blue and purple spheres with reflections - Use for Hero 3D textures or fallback background
White minimal architecture - Use for clean service section background or about us

mockups.description: Employer dashboard showing application trends - Use in 'How It Works' or 'Results' section

logos.description: Generic white bag/logo placeholder - Use for trust strip
Orange card with 'one' logo - Use for trust strip

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `yarn add three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei framer-motion framer-motion-3d react-fast-marquee lucide-react`
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) for all components.

Implement a global `<Canvas>` component in the main App layout that covers the entire screen (`position: fixed, top: 0, left: 0, z-index: -1`). Add lighting (`<ambientLight>`, `<directionalLight>`) and floating shapes using `<Float>` from drei.
Overlay standard DOM elements on top using Framer Motion for scroll reveals. Use high-end glassmorphism for cards so the 3D shapes are visible behind them.
Use the `MeshPhysicalMaterial` from Three.js for shapes to achieve the requested 'glassy sky blue' and 'white' aesthetic. Reference the `3d_materials` spec in this JSON.
For specific 3D elements inside DOM (like a 3D card), you can embed separate small `<Canvas>` elements inside the specific component div, or use Framer Motion 3D.
Ensure all sections (Hero, Services, Pricing, etc.) heavily utilize vertical spacing (p-24) to allow room for background parallax effects.
Implement the floating WhatsApp button as a fixed element with a continuous y-axis Framer Motion animation.
DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDERS. Use the image_urls provided in this guideline for textures and mockups.
